description: This file provides debugging APIs for hash table probing behavior, including functions to get probe counts, histograms, summaries, and memory usage related to hash tables in the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: HashtableDebugProbeSummary
classes.description: Structure holding summary statistics of hash table probe counts, including total elements, total probes, and mean probes.

methods.name: GetHashtableDebugNumProbes
methods.description: Returns the number of probes required to lookup a key in the container.

methods.name: GetHashtableDebugNumProbesHistogram
methods.description: Returns a histogram of probe counts for all elements in the container.

methods.name: GetHashtableDebugProbeSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the probe count distribution for the container.

methods.name: AllocatedByteSize
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes allocated for the container that are not freed.

methods.name: LowerBoundAllocatedByteSize
methods.description: Provides a tight lower bound on the allocated byte size for a given number of elements.
